source.author: verg
source.text: Ecce, maris magna claudit nos obice pontus, deest iam terra fugae: pelagus Troiamne petemus?
source.text_original: Ecce, maris magna claudit nos obice pontus, / deest iam terra fugae: pelagus Troiamne petemus?'
source.text_english: Look, the great sea bars us with its obstacle; now land for escape is lacking: shall we seek the sea or Troy?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nil animi, nil regna iuvant; fremit obice ponti clausa cohors telisque salum facibusque coruscat.
reuse.text_original: nil animi, nil regna iuvant; fremit obice ponti / clausa cohors telisque salum facibusque coruscat.
reuse.text_english: Neither courage nor kingdoms help; the enclosed host roars at the barrier of the sea, and the swell flashes with weapons and torches.
